rubric_hint.rule: 4 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: The notification is a 4.1 ha regeneration felling in Skara. Completed felling overlaps only 0.2% of the polygon (0.008 ha, felled 2006).
There are no red-listed records within 250 m, and none inside the polygon. Near-site effort is 13 records on 8 days within 250 m, against a county median of 1 record.

Four eligible site-bound species are recorded 783-920 m away. Gyalecta ulmi (EN, lichen) and Hymenochaete ulmicola (EN, fungus) are both at 783 m, with records from 2025 and 5 m uncertainty. Two VU beetles, Colydium elongatum and Cossonus parallelepipedus, are at 920 m with 300 m uncertainty and records from 2020 and 2017. Their listed threats include lack of continuity forest, old/large trees and dead wood.
Effort in the 1000 m ring is adequate (2523 records, 97th percentile), so the absence of records within 250 m is not just a result of little recording.

uncertainties: The eligible records are 783 m or more from the polygon. Whether similar habitat extends to the site is unknown.
The beetle records have 300 m uncertainty and are older (2017 and 2020).
43 records were dropped for coordinate uncertainty in the 1000 m ring.
not_established: That any red-listed species occupies the polygon.
That the site is free of threatened species. Absence of records is not absence of species.
next_action: Reviewer should check whether the habitat around the 783 m elm-associated lichen and fungus records extends toward the polygon. They should consider a field survey before felling starts.
